junro.title: Prioritree MCP — the agent-callable surface: the core's five-op interface exposed as OunceMCP tools — the banked tooling decision realized (the tier's own effort: composition, gates, the exposure's shape), the core staying zero-dep; the surface USABLE BY THE APPROPRIATE TEAM MEMBERS, not only external agents; the full junro, all seats participating
inputs: Q-mcp-surface's banked ruling at the prioritree-core store (2026-11-20): the MCP surface uses OunceMCP (subbusainath.github.io/ouncemcp/ — a Python framework on FastMCP: token-budgeted tool definitions and results, idempotent writes replayed never repeated, approvals before changes, verified-token identity, caller-bound handles, large-catalog discovery, proof tooling); the five ops land as its tools; the core stays zero-dep; OunceMCP rides the MCP tier's wrapper, exactly as the CLI wraps, FastAPI serves, and the web fronts

THE COLLABORATOR'S CONVENING RULING (2026-11-22): the MCP surface must be usable BY THE APPROPRIATE TEAM MEMBERS — the agent-facing analogue of the member-callable law (prioritree-ux R12/R13): the appropriate seats call/interact with the MCP tools directly from their own seats (a member-facing client path, a tool grant, or the MCP server's own callable surface — the design rules the form)

the service era's whole record (the prioritree-ux effort, done 2026-11-22): the six JSON routes (the five ops + the manifest query) live and ThreePart 21/21; the web tier live (the comparator's flow whole); the lifecycle targets + the member-callable lifecycle tool (the grant map's own precedent — the form this effort extends to the MCP tier)

the standing laws carried from prioritree-ux (R1-R13): the full-junro all-seats mandate; the seat-authored report (R6/R11 — the record never rides the return channel); the per-step dispatch (R8 — one step, one dispatch, one bounded return); the ThreePart error shape mandatory (R5); the member-callable surface + the readable runtime (R12/R13)
CONTINUATION.md's WHERE section (the named next era: the MCP-surface effort composing at the collaborator's hand)

structure.purpose: THE PER-UNIT PIPELINE (the standing form): THE CENSUS FIRST — ungated tansa/shindan/rikai packets over the MCP-era ground (OunceMCP's own surface, the exposure shape today, the member-path design space); then THE DESIGN LANE — ungated suisen/keisan/hyoka/moho packets; then togo's gated synthesis closing G-MCP-DESIGN-BRIEF; each build unit's ungated discovery legs + gated brief precede its build; THE ROUTE GROWS UNIT-BY-UNIT (the build-add auto-stamps the pair; the spec lane rides the unique suffix — the two-lane standing shape).
structure.entry_condition: G-COMPOSITION is green (the composition validated at the route's head); the census fires first, its findings assumed by none of this composition.

structure.purpose: THE MCP TIER'S BUILD — the units the census and design earn (the likely set, named not pinned: mcp-server — the OunceMCP wrapper over the five ops; member-path — the members' callable surface; lifecycle integration — the MCP server's own start/stop riding the standing form), one module per dispatch (R8's per-step law at build time), each landing per its approved brief (the exact-task law), kensho's independent verification per build gate, one-commit-per-increment; the ThreePart mandatory at the tools' refusals; the core zero-dep held.
structure.entry_condition: G-MCP-DESIGN-BRIEF is green — the design is the spec; each unit's own G-<UNIT>-BRIEF green before its dispatch (the precedence law).

structure.purpose: THE EFFORT'S BOOKEND (the standing form): hansei's retro (the friction ledger the intake), the effort's records (the CONTINUATION entry; the next era named — the widening paths banked or the collaborator's next call), the done call at the collaborator's ruling.
structure.entry_condition: the route's build gates closed green and the collaborator has called the close.

conditions: the composition lands at the store's reports home (reports/compose/route.md — keikaku's own report, the composition whole: stages, gates, increments, the ungated placements, the application order) — the opening whole, the census placed FIRST with none of its findings assumed, every seat placed (R4: no seat bypassed)

every choice cites its ruling: Q-mcp-tools' three (the banked OunceMCP decision, the member-usable law, the governance form) + the standing laws carried from prioritree-ux (R1-R13 as the inputs name them)
the collaborator validates the composition — the gate is the validation; the outcome records against compose/route; no route dispatch fires before it is green

THE DESIGN BRIEF LANDED: togo's synthesis over the census (census/ouncemcp, census/exposure, census/member-path) + the design lane (design/tools, design/member-path, design/budgets, design/adversarial, design/blind-walk); a divergence that survives reconciliation blocks the brief, never rides silently

the brief carries the design-work whole the rulings leave open: the five tools' definitions + budgets (the banked decision's discipline), the member-usable path's form + the minimum-grant map + the same stamps comparator_id/class (the member-usable law), the ThreePart seam (R5 carried — the tools' refusals carry expected/found/next-action), the discipline mapping (idempotency=R9's dedup, budgets=narrow-interface, approvals/handles=write-path strictness)
THE COLLABORATOR'S APPROVAL: the design judged ready-to-build; the build units' briefs cite it; their dispatches fire only after their own brief gates green
hansei's retro landed: the debrief over the effort whole, the friction ledger the intake, the lessons named

the effort's records landed: the CONTINUATION entry (the landing state named honestly); the next era named (the MCP surface's successors — the widening paths banked: multi-process, auth, the both-directions probe — or the collaborator's next call)
the collaborator rules the close — the done call recorded same-turn; the route's status set done at the ruling

the exact-task spec landed — togo's bytes whole over the approved design brief: the five tools' definitions verbatim (the authored descriptions, the params, the return models, the error forms), the seam module's bytes, the dep's landing, the two run forms, the per-step dispatch plan (R8)
the spec carries the concurrency cure whole (the machine-wide flock seam: the module + the three compositions — server, service_store, CLI — the honest state, the never-deleted lockfile)
the collaborator approves the spec — the build dispatches fire only after

the five tools live per the approved spec — the exact-task law: the definitions verbatim (the authored descriptions teaching the arc, the halt's exit, the stamps' convention; the effects; the params with the core's static bounds; the return models with acknowledged's ruled semantics), the ThreePart at the refusals (R5), DONE a value never an error, the HALT honest with the K=10 cap

the machine-wide flock seam live and composed by ALL writer tiers (the server, service_store.py, cli.py) — the honest concurrency state, the lockfile never deleted; the two run forms (stdio + the shared HTTP form's server side)
the floor green (pyright 0/0, ruff zero findings, ouncemcp the landed dep) + kensho's independent re-run green (validate/mcp-server)

MOHO'S IMPLEMENTATION WALK (Q-mcp-tools R4): the uninstructed live walk of the five tools end-to-end — the cold-agent journey on the real surface, the ease-of-use findings riding this gate as evidence

THE BUILD BRIEF for the unit mcp-server LANDED and APPROVED: togo's synthesis over the unit's discovery census (discover/mcp-server) + mechanism analysis (understand/mcp-server) — the brief carrying the banked shapes, the scope fence, and the return forms — the dispatches cite this brief
THE COLLABORATOR'S APPROVAL: the brief judged ready-to-build; the unit's dispatches fire only after

the exact-task spec landed — the collaborator's-hand bytes whole: the hikari-source rows (the yaml's tool grants per the map) + the mcp block's wiring (command/args/enabled per the design's F6) + the regen + restart acts named in order

the grant map carried verbatim (the design's ruling): full five at jikko/kensho/shinko; read three at rikai/shindan; deny at the other eight — the rows' exact form per the lifecycle precedent's emitted shape
the collaborator approves — the hand fires only after (the hikari edit at their hand, the regen, the restart — the delivery point)

the delivery note lands whole (the in-tree act: the hikari copy-paste block at the evidence home carried into the unit's report verbatim; the delivery note's steps in order — the hikari edit, the regen, the emission, THE RESTART per FR-MEM-0014)

THE POST-RESTART LIVE CHECK GREEN (the collaborator's hand delivered — the restart done): shinko's own session, the first granted session, calls register + tally on a scratch list THROUGH the member path; the store's ground verified — the run file landing at {repo}/.prioritree/runs (the CWD seam's truth: the project-scoped spawn confirmed); the grant map verified live (the full five callable at the working seats, the read three at the analysis seats)

MOHO'S FULL LIVE WALK (FR-MEM-0030's cure — Q-mcp-tools R4): the uninstructed walk of the five tools through the member path itself — moho's own blind calls end-to-end, the ease-of-use evidence riding this gate
the floor green (200 passed stands; kensho's independent re-run)

THE BUILD BRIEF for the unit member-path LANDED and APPROVED: togo's synthesis over the unit's discovery census (discover/member-path) + mechanism analysis (understand/member-path) — the brief carrying the banked shapes, the scope fence, and the return forms — the dispatches cite this brief
THE COLLABORATOR'S APPROVAL: the brief judged ready-to-build; the unit's dispatches fire only after

the exact-task spec landed — the bytes whole over the approved design: the MCP server's HTTP run form's make targets (the standing lifecycle form extended: the --serve flag's port/host discipline, the pidfile's home, the read-back probes), the port collision cured (the 8100 widening or the spec's ruled form), the README's serve lines current
the targets green live per the standing read-back forms (start = the port answering; stop = the refusal; the /healthz form if the spec rules it)
the collaborator approves — the build fires only after

the MCP server's HTTP lifecycle targets land per the approved spec — the exact-task law: the standing make-target form extended (the --serve flag's targets, the pidfile/log homes, the read-back probes, the port discipline ruled)

the targets green live: mcp-start brings the server up (the read-back: the port answering — the /healthz form or the spec's probe); mcp-stop brings it down (the refusal); the port collision with the web tier's 8000 cured per the spec's ruling

the floor green (200 passed stands; zero Python touched if the targets ride the Makefile alone — or the suite grown if the spec rules arcs); kensho's independent re-run green (validate/lifecycleintegration)

THE BUILD BRIEF for the unit lifecycleintegration LANDED and APPROVED: togo's synthesis over the unit's discovery census (discover/lifecycleintegration) + mechanism analysis (understand/lifecycleintegration) — the brief carrying the banked shapes, the scope fence, and the return forms — the dispatches cite this brief
THE COLLABORATOR'S APPROVAL: the brief judged ready-to-build; the unit's dispatches fire only after

amendments.what: add-question {"question": "Q-mcp-tools", "text": "What is prioritree's MCP surface — the core's five-op interface (register_run, next_pair, cast_vote, read_vote_state, tally_rank) exposed as OunceMCP tools (the banked ruling realized), the tier's own shape (composition, gates, the exposure's budgeting/approval/handle discipline), the core staying zero-dep — AND the surface usable by the appropriate team members directly from their own seats (the member-callable law's agent-facing analogue)?"}
amendments.why: junro route-op provenance stamp (design-spec §6: every route op stamps actor, timestamp, and arguments into the route's amendments)

amendments.what: add-ruling {"question": "Q-mcp-tools", "ruling": "THE BANKED DECISION CARRIED (Q-mcp-surface's ruling at the prioritree-core store, 2026-11-20, realized by this effort): the MCP surface uses OunceMCP (subbusainath.github.io/ouncemcp/ — a Python framework built on FastMCP: small tool definitions, results that fit the context window, token-budgeted tools and results, idempotent writes replayed never repeated, approvals before changes, verified-token identity, caller-bound handles, large-catalog discovery, proof tooling). THE FIVE OPS LAND AS ITS TOOLS: register_run, next_pair, cast_vote, read_vote_state, tally_rank — the same interface the CLI wraps, FastAPI serves, and the web fronts. THE CORE STAYS ZERO-DEP (the ruled data plane); OunceMCP rides the MCP tier's wrapper. THE RESONANCE (recorded at the bank): the framework's built-ins implement the product's own ruled disciplines — idempotent writes replayed-never-repeated is R9's loud idempotent dedup; token-budgeted small tool definitions is the narrow-interface doctrine; approvals-before-changes and caller-bound handles harden the write path where the design spends its strictness."}
amendments.why: junro route-op provenance stamp (design-spec §6: every route op stamps actor, timestamp, and arguments into the route's amendments)

amendments.what: add-ruling {"question": "Q-mcp-tools", "ruling": "THE MEMBER-USABLE MCP LAW (collaborator ruling, 2026-11-22, verbatim ground: \"we need to also be able to use the MCP from the appropriate team members.\"): the MCP surface is NOT only an external-agent-facing tier — THE APPROPRIATE TEAM MEMBERS use it directly from their own seats: the agent-facing analogue of the member-callable law (prioritree-ux R12/R13, whose lifecycle tool is the standing precedent). THE REQUIREMENT: a member-facing path to the MCP tools (the design rules the form — a member-callable MCP client path, a tool grant wrapping the client, the MCP server's own callable surface exposed to the seats, or another form the design settles); the appropriate seats' map (which members get which tools — the minimum-grant principle, the lifecycle grant map's own form); the members' calls carrying the same stamps the external agents carry (comparator_id, class — the vote's provenance whole). THE STANDING PRECEDENT CARRIED: the lifecycle tool's grant map (full at the working seats, read at the analysis seats, deny elsewhere) is the form this effort extends; the FR-MEM-0014 drift lesson rides (the grant lands at the tree, the delivery at the launch — the restart note)."}

amendments.what: add-ruling {"question": "Q-mcp-tools", "ruling": "THE GOVERNANCE FORM CARRIED (the full junro, all seats — the ux effort's standing law R4, held at this effort from birth): every seat rides the route — keikaku composes; tansa, shindan, and rikai discover and diagnose (the MCP-era ground: OunceMCP's own surface, the banked decision's fit, the FastMCP substrate); suisen and keisan recommend and calculate (the exposure's shape, the tool definitions' budgets); hyoka assesses adversarially; moho blind-walks; togo synthesizes; jikko executes per-step; kensho verifies independently; hansei debriefs; shinko dispatches. amendments.what: add-ruling {"question": "Q-mcp-tools", "ruling": "THE PER-STEP LAW SHARPENED — THE FILE IS THE STEP-UNIT (collaborator correction, 2026-11-22, verbatim ground: \"that was for sure a fat dispatch.\" — the step-3 compositions dispatch, build/mcp-server): R8's ONE STEP ONE DISPATCH sharpens to the FILE: a step-dispatch carries ONE file's landing (or the smallest coherent unit — one region set in one file), NEVER a multi-file region set. The build/mcp-server step-3 dispatch carried service_store.py's six hunks + cli.py's five hunks + both imports + the docstring amendments + two lint fixes + a full floor run in one session — the step-GROUP form (R7's superseded shape) striking despite the approved plan's own \"compositions\" step-bundling: the spec's step plan inherits the law too — multi-file steps decompose per-file at the plan's authoring, and the convenor's dispatches follow the decomposed plan. WHAT SAVED IT: R11's per-step report — the record rode the packet (jikko's own report, the floor's outcomes verbatim), the return landed whole; the fat dispatch's hazard is record-loss at the transit seam, and the per-step report is the guard — the survival is the law's proof, not the dispatch's defense. THE LANDED WORK STANDS (verified: 156 passed, pyright 0/0, ruff zero — behavior-transparent, the floor held); the correction shapes the REMAINING steps (the two test files decompose into two dispatches; the single-file steps ride as-is) and the standing form at every route: the file is the step-unit, the plan decomposes per-file, the dispatch follows."}

open_questions.question: What is prioritree's MCP surface — the core's five-op interface (register_run, next_pair, cast_vote, read_vote_state, tally_rank) exposed as OunceMCP tools (the banked ruling realized), the tier's own shape (composition, gates, the exposure's budgeting/approval/handle discipline), the core staying zero-dep — AND the surface usable by the appropriate team members directly from their own seats (the member-callable law's agent-facing analogue)?

rulings.text: THE BANKED DECISION CARRIED (Q-mcp-surface's ruling at the prioritree-core store, 2026-11-20, realized by this effort): the MCP surface uses OunceMCP (subbusainath.github.io/ouncemcp/ — a Python framework built on FastMCP: small tool definitions, results that fit the context window, token-budgeted tools and results, idempotent writes replayed never repeated, approvals before changes, verified-token identity, caller-bound handles, large-catalog discovery, proof tooling). THE FIVE OPS LAND AS ITS TOOLS: register_run, next_pair, cast_vote, read_vote_state, tally_rank — the same interface the CLI wraps, FastAPI serves, and the web fronts. THE CORE STAYS ZERO-DEP (the ruled data plane); OunceMCP rides the MCP tier's wrapper. THE RESONANCE (recorded at the bank): the framework's built-ins implement the product's own ruled disciplines — idempotent writes replayed-never-repeated is R9's loud idempotent dedup; token-budgeted small tool definitions is the narrow-interface doctrine; approvals-before-changes and caller-bound handles harden the write path where the design spends its strictness.

THE MEMBER-USABLE MCP LAW (collaborator ruling, 2026-11-22, verbatim ground: "we need to also be able to use the MCP from the appropriate team members."): the MCP surface is NOT only an external-agent-facing tier — THE APPROPRIATE TEAM MEMBERS use it directly from their own seats: the agent-facing analogue of the member-callable law (prioritree-ux R12/R13, whose lifecycle tool is the standing precedent). THE REQUIREMENT: a member-facing path to the MCP tools (the design rules the form — a member-callable MCP client path, a tool grant wrapping the client, the MCP server's own callable surface exposed to the seats, or another form the design settles); the appropriate seats' map (which members get which tools — the minimum-grant principle, the lifecycle grant map's own form); the members' calls carrying the same stamps the external agents carry (comparator_id, class — the vote's provenance whole). THE STANDING PRECEDENT CARRIED: the lifecycle tool's grant map (full at the working seats, read at the analysis seats, deny elsewhere) is the form this effort extends; the FR-MEM-0014 drift lesson rides (the grant lands at the tree, the delivery at the launch — the restart note).

THE GOVERNANCE FORM CARRIED (the full junro, all seats — the ux effort's standing law R4, held at this effort from birth): every seat rides the route — keikaku composes; tansa, shindan, and rikai discover and diagnose (the MCP-era ground: OunceMCP's own surface, the banked decision's fit, the FastMCP substrate); suisen and keisan recommend and calculate (the exposure's shape, the tool definitions' budgets); hyoka assesses adversarially; moho blind-walks; togo synthesizes; jikko executes per-step; kensho verifies independently; hansei debriefs; shinko dispatches. THE STANDING LAWS RIDE WHOLE: the seat-authored report (R6/R11 — the record never rides the return channel); the per-step dispatch (R8 — one step, one dispatch, one bounded return; the spec's sequence IS the dispatch plan); the TwoPart brief→spec→build form (the two-lane standing shape); the ThreePart error shape mandatory (R5 — the MCP tools' refusals carry expected/found/next-action as the wire's family grammar does); the transit-envelope discipline (the set-form evidence, the sized dispatches).

THE IMPLEMENTATION WALK LAW (collaborator ruling, 2026-11-22, verbatim ground: "moho can also walk the actual implementation for feedback on ease of use" / "as in using the mcp without instruction to assess how intuitive it use is."): moho's blind walk extends beyond the design lane to the BUILT SURFACE — the actual MCP implementation walked UNINSTRUCTED: moho uses the live tools with no instruction (the real definitions served, the real refusals, the real flow end-to-end), assessing how intuitive the implementation is to use; the walk's findings (the breakages, the guesses, the stuck moments) ride the build gate's evidence as the ease-of-use datum. THE TWO WALKS BOOKEND THE BUILD: the design walk (pre-build — do the definitions teach the sequence, the stamps, the signals? moho's current findings folded into the definitions) + the implementation walk (post-build — the real thing usable cold?); the findings feed the gate's ruling, never silently ride. THE STANDING FORM: every agent/user-facing surface's build gate carries the implementation walk alongside kensho's zero-trust verification — the verification plan's constituent, named in the design brief, landed in the unit's gate conditions. At this effort: the mcp-server unit's build gate carries moho's implementation walk of the live tools; the walk's report is the ease-of-use evidence the collaborator rules on at the gate.

THE PER-STEP LAW SHARPENED — THE FILE IS THE STEP-UNIT (collaborator correction, 2026-11-22, verbatim ground: "that was for sure a fat dispatch." — the step-3 compositions dispatch, build/mcp-server): R8's ONE STEP ONE DISPATCH sharpens to the FILE: a step-dispatch carries ONE file's landing (or the smallest coherent unit — one region set in one file), NEVER a multi-file region set. The build/mcp-server step-3 dispatch carried service_store.py's six hunks + cli.py's five hunks + both imports + the docstring amendments + two lint fixes + a full floor run in one session — the step-GROUP form (R7's superseded shape) striking despite the approved plan's own "compositions" step-bundling: the spec's step plan inherits the law too — multi-file steps decompose per-file at the plan's authoring, and the convenor's dispatches follow the decomposed plan. WHAT SAVED IT: R11's per-step report — the record rode the packet (jikko's own report, the floor's outcomes verbatim), the return landed whole; the fat dispatch's hazard is record-loss at the transit seam, and the per-step report is the guard — the survival is the law's proof, not the dispatch's defense. THE LANDED WORK STANDS (verified: 156 passed, pyright 0/0, ruff zero — behavior-transparent, the floor held); the correction shapes the REMAINING steps (the two test files decompose into two dispatches; the single-file steps ride as-is) and the standing form at every route: the file is the step-unit, the plan decomposes per-file, the dispatch follows.

THE COLLABORATOR'S LEANING recorded: "maybe the tool starts it and runs it?" — the shared-server form. THE DELIVERABLE NAMED: the spec carries THE EXACT COPY-PASTE for the hikari side (whatever form is ruled — the fragment's bytes, the yaml rows, the fragment hikari emits — the collaborator's hand gets a paste-able block, never a description of one). THE PRICING AXES: the stdio-per-session form (the design's current ruling — the harness spawns per-session servers, the MemoryStore replay resetting per session) vs the shared-HTTP form (one server, the replay persisting, the tool managing the lifecycle); the restart law (config read at launch — the switch flips at the restart); the design's own two-run-forms ruling (one server, stdio + --serve).

MOHO'S GRANT: PERMANENT (collaborator ruling, 2026-11-23, verbatim: "Moho grant is permanent."): the walking seat's five-tool grant stands permanent — moho joins the working seats' line in the grant map (the full five: prioritree_runs_register/next, prioritree_votes_cast/census, prioritree_runs_tally, all "allow"; the Pack Routing row carried). The banked trigger CLOSED: the grant's fate ruled, no revocation cycle, no further regen/restart required — the standing emission IS the permanent form. The rationale named for the record: the walker's surface is the loop's own evidence instrument (R4's implementation-walk law — the full live walk at every agent-facing surface's gate); a permanent grant keeps the instrument seated, the next walk's dispatch needing no config cycle.
